title: Number Series Patterns: The Complete Catalogue

questions.question: What is the next term in the series 3, 5, 8, 12, 17, ?
questions.rationale: The differences are 2, 3, 4, 5 — increasing by 1 each step — so the next difference is 6 and the answer is 17 + 6 = 23.

questions.question: What is the next term in the series 3, 7, 16, 35, 74, ?
questions.rationale: The rule is multiply by 2 and add a rising number: 3x2+1=7, 7x2+2=16, 16x2+3=35, 35x2+4=74, so the next term is 74x2+5 = 153. Option 148 is the near-miss from continuing with +4.

questions.question: The series 2, 6, 12, 20, 30 follows which pattern?
questions.rationale: Each term equals its position squared plus its position: 1^2+1=2, 2^2+2=6, 3^2+3=12, 4^2+4=20, 5^2+5=30. The pronic pattern makes the next term 6^2+6 = 42.

questions.question: What is the next term in the series 0, 7, 26, 63, 124, ?
questions.rationale: Each term is one less than a cube: 1^3-1, 2^3-1, 3^3-1, 4^3-1, 5^3-1, so the next term is 6^3-1 = 215.

questions.question: What is the next term in the series 1, 3, 6, 11, 18, 29, ?
questions.rationale: The differences are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 — the primes in order — so the next difference is the next prime, 13, giving 29 + 13 = 42.

questions.question: What is the next term in the series 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, ?
questions.rationale: This is the factorial family: each term multiplies by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in turn, so the next term is 120 x 6 = 720.

questions.question: What is the next term in the interleaved series 4, 10, 9, 20, 14, 30, 19, ?
questions.rationale: Odd positions give 4, 9, 14, 19 (+5 each time) and even positions give 10, 20, 30 (+10 each time). The blank is an even position, so the answer is 30 + 10 = 40.

questions.question: In the series 50, 45, 47, 42, 44, 39, ?, what rule connects the terms?
options: Two interleaved series both falling by 5
questions.rationale: The differences alternate -5, +2, -5, +2, -5, so the next difference is +2 and the answer is 39 + 2 = 41. This is the alternating-difference sub-pattern of the differences family.

questions.question: In the digit-based series 25, 32, 37, 47, 58, ?, what is the next term?
questions.rationale: Each term is the previous term plus the sum of its own digits: 58 + (5+8) = 58 + 13 = 71.

questions.question: According to the master test order, what should you check immediately after differences and ratios both fail?
options: Split the series into two interleaved series
questions.rationale: The master strategy tests in order: differences, ratios, then squares and cubes against position, then primes and factorials, then interleaved series, and only then digit rules.
